name: smith squat to bench
description: A smith machine squat down to a bench behind you. The bench gives a consistent depth target.
instructions: Place a bench behind you under the smith bar.
Rest the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.
